column1: # Evora fork: display override catalog ("catalogue de surcharge d'affichage", patches E10 and E9).
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  language code <TAB> English source <TAB> text to display
#   language  en, es, fr, id, ja, pt-br, zh-cn, de, ru, uk, it, ko (Language::code)
#   source    the English text the code asks for (tl!/tlf! literal, menu label, or a name the UI
#             translates with i18n::t), exactly as in the code and the upstream catalogs
#   display   what this build shows instead, in that language
# Lookup in Language::tr: this file for the language, then the upstream catalog of the language,
# then this file for English (the corrected source text), then the source itself. The upstream
# catalogs (*.tsv) stay untouched, so they rebase cleanly; only what is displayed changes.
# Escapes and placeholders follow es.tsv: \n \t \\ ; `{name}` placeholders must appear in both
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# --- E10: no emoji or pictograph in the interface (Evora rule "zéro émoji d'interface") ----------
# Check marks and crosses (U+2713, U+2714, U+2716) in catalog strings become words.
# --- E9: neutral names instead of third-party product names (D-16, proposals pending review) -----
# Lumetri (Adobe) → color grading. Every language whose upstream catalog translates the string has
# its own row; the others fall back to the English row. Lightroom, Acrobat, Cycore: not in this
# repository's displayed strings (measured). Identifiers (effect "lumetri", panel ids, command ids)
# are unchanged: only what is displayed.
